title: The viewer sends an edit that the neovim plugin applies to the buffer
body:
The `--stdio` link (`crates/acre-gui/src/link.rs`, `editors/nvim/lua/acre/init.lua`) carries `text` and `cursor` into acre-gui and `goto`, `error` and `ok` out. Nothing carries a change to the source back to the editor.

## Proposal

- An outgoing message `edit`, holding a list of `{start, end, text}` byte ranges in the source acre-gui last received, and the `tick` of that source.
- The `text` message carries neovim's `changedtick` as `tick`. acre-gui keeps the tick with the text it built from.
- The plugin applies an `edit` with `nvim_buf_set_text` only when the buffer's `changedtick` still equals the edit's tick, ranges applied from last to first so earlier offsets stay valid. Otherwise it drops the edit and sends the text again.
- All ranges of one edit are one undo step.
close_reason: Landed in a220913. `Outgoing::Edit` and the `tick` on `Incoming::Text` are in `crates/acre-gui/src/link.rs`, and `App::send_edits` is in `app.rs` for the drag to call. The plugin's `apply` and the `edit` branch of `receive` are in `editors/nvim/lua/acre/init.lua`. Tests are in `editors/nvim/tests/`.
